rules.message: WARNING: You have reported symptoms (chest pain, shortness of breath) that the CDC identifies as emergency warning signs. Seek emergency medical care immediately. Do not rely on this application for a diagnosis.
rules.reason: Chest pain or shortness of breath are critical indicators of potential myocardial infarction or severe respiratory distress.
rules.source: CDC Emergency Warning Signs for Cardiovascular and Respiratory Issues
rules.notes: Matches if any of the symptoms are present.

rules.message: WARNING: You have reported severe neurological symptoms. Seek emergency medical care immediately.
rules.reason: Severe neurological signs like slurred speech, confusion, fainting, or seizures can indicate critical conditions such as stroke or severe trauma.
rules.source: CDC Stroke and Neurological Emergency Signs
rules.notes: Matches if any of the symptoms are present.
